text: Choose a dark theme with a high-contrast light toggle for Excava’s interface. This maximizes visibility in low-light settings while ensuring accessibility for users who need lighter contrast. name: Pane
text: Pane: A high-contrast light toggle doesn’t solve glare—users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency still face readability issues in either mode. Instead, offer a single high-contrast dark theme with adjustable color saturation and font scaling; settle the argument by testing both solutions with real users in low-light conditions and measuring task completion time.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single high-contrast dark theme with adjustable saturation and font scaling still locks users into a dark aesthetic—glare isn’t the only problem, but it’s the most common one. Offer a *dual-mode system* with a *true high-contrast light theme* (not just a toggle) and a dark theme, then test glare reduction, readability, and user preference in a 2-week A/B trial with astigmatic and color-blind users.
